# Dent Dock

> Dental practice management software for UK private practices — online booking, automated reminders, payments and recalls.

Dent Dock helps UK private dental practices run their day-to-day: patients book online, reminders go out automatically over SMS and email, payments are taken without chasing, and recalls keep chairs full. Built for private and mixed practices (no NHS UDA management). No contracts, no setup fees, live within the day.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What DentDock does, support, switching, pricing summary, FAQ and waitlist signup.
- [Features](/features): Online booking, patient portal, reminders and recalls, forms, payments and reports.
- [Pricing](/pricing): £49 a month per practice, what's included, plans coming soon.
- [Calendar](/features/calendar): Diary with a column per clinician, visit statuses, hours, leave and blocked time.
- [Online booking and portal](/features/online-booking): Booking page with prices, health forms in the booking, patient portal.
- [Forms and medical history](/features/forms): Form templates and builder, signatures, reminders, medical history saved to the record.
- [Payments and deposits](/features/payments): Payment links, deposits, cancellation fees, refunds and numbered receipts via the practice's own Stripe.
- [Reports](/features/reports): Money taken, no-show rates, booking sources, accountant export.
- [Security and data](/features/security): London storage, encryption, two-step login, team access, data export.
- [Switching to DentDock](/features/switching): Guided setup and CSV patient import.
- [Reminders and recalls](/features/reminders-and-recalls): Reminders 72, 24 and 2 hours before each appointment, recall follow-ups, waitlist.
- [Reduce no-shows](/solutions/reduce-no-shows): Evidence on reminders, fair cancellation fees, refilling gaps.
- [Fill cancelled appointments](/solutions/fill-cancelled-appointments): Waitlist offers for cancelled slots.
- [Cut admin and phone time](/solutions/cut-admin): Booking, forms, reminders and recalls that run themselves.
- [Deposits and late cancellations](/solutions/deposits-and-late-cancellations): Deposits on chosen treatments and fees decided case by case.
- [Bring patients back](/solutions/bring-patients-back): Recalls with follow-ups and Google review links.
- [Going private](/solutions/going-private): Software for practices moving to private care.
- [New practices](/solutions/new-practices): Set up a new practice in a day.
